faq.q: Can you really provide vegan catering on a yacht charter in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes, absolutely. All our charters include a selection of snacks and drinks, and we can tailor the menu to be fully plant-based. Just let us know your dietary requirements when booking, and we'll arrange fresh vegan options like hummus, grilled vegetables, fruit platters, and more.

faq.q: What vegan dishes are typically served on board?
faq.a: Our standard menu includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava, plus light snacks. For vegan guests, we swap in items like marinated olives, bruschetta with tomato and basil, fresh fruit skewers, and a Mediterranean salad. For longer charters, we can arrange a full plant-based lunch or dinner.

faq.q: Is the vegan catering included in the price?
faq.a: Yes, the standard inclusions (skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, IVA) are always included. Swapping to vegan options doesn't add a surcharge – it's simply a matter of preference. For bespoke menus, we can provide a quote via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Which boats are best for a vegan yacht charter in Marbella?
faq.a: For a small group, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are great value at €749/2h. For a larger party, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski. All boats depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: Can you cater for other dietary restrictions too?
faq.a: Of course. Whether you're gluten-free, nut-free, or have other allergies, we can adapt the menu. Just specify your needs when booking, and we'll ensure the snacks and drinks are suitable. For more complex requirements, we recommend booking in advance.

faq.q: How far in advance should I request vegan catering?
faq.a: We recommend letting us know at least 24 hours before your charter. This gives us time to source fresh local produce. For last-minute bookings, we'll do our best to accommodate – just send a WhatsApp message to confirm.

faq.q: Do you offer full vegan meals for longer charters?
faq.a: Yes, for 6-hour or 8-hour charters, we can arrange a full plant-based meal, such as a Mediterranean quinoa salad, grilled vegetable skewers, and a fruit dessert. Prices for bespoke catering are available on request via WhatsApp.

data.body_html:
Planning a vegan-friendly yacht charter in Marbella? You're in luck. Our entire fleet, departing from Puerto Banús, can be catered with delicious plant-based menus – no extra fuss, no compromise on flavour. From fresh fruit platters to Mediterranean tapas, we ensure your day at sea is as tasty as it is scenic. And with the skipper, fuel, drinks, and IVA all included, you can relax and enjoy the views of La Concha and the Costa del Sol.

Why choose a vegan yacht charter in Marbella?

Marbella is known for its fresh Mediterranean produce, and we bring that straight to your boat. Whether you're cruising past the Golden Mile or anchoring at Cala del Faro, our vegan catering is designed to complement the sea air. You'll get a spread of colourful salads, creamy hummus, marinated olives, and seasonal fruit – all plant-based and all included in your charter price.

Our vegan menu highlights

Here's a taste of what we can serve on board:

  • Fresh fruit platters (watermelon, pineapple, grapes)
  • Hummus with crudités and pita bread
  • Mediterranean salad with olives, cherry tomatoes, and cucumber
  • Grilled vegetable skewers (for longer charters)
  • Vegan tapas like patatas bravas and garlic mushrooms
  • Plant-based desserts – fruit sorbet or chocolate brownies

All paired with our standard drinks: water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. Just let us know your preferences when booking.

Which boats can I book for a vegan charter?

All our boats can be catered vegan. For a budget-friendly option, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are available from €749 for 2 hours, including skipper and drinks. For a larger group, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. Other boats – like the Ferretti 94 or Pershing 46 – are priced on request via WhatsApp.

What's included in every charter?

Every single charter includes:

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (vegan options available)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

No hidden costs – just show up and enjoy.

How to book your vegan yacht charter

Booking is simple. Head to our main charter page to see the full fleet, or send us a WhatsApp message to discuss your vegan menu. We recommend booking at least 24 hours in advance so we can source the freshest local ingredients. For last-minute requests, we'll do our best to accommodate.

Popular vegan-friendly routes from Puerto Banús

Set sail from Puerto Banús and explore the coast. A 2-hour cruise can take you past the Marbella Marina and towards Cabopino. For a half-day, head to Cala Cortés or anchor near Estepona. Longer charters can reach Sotogrande. All routes offer stunning views of the Sierra Blanca and La Concha mountain.
